meta.title: A bid with no products is refused on submission
gaps: the plan has the buyer send PATCH /v1/bids/{{bidUuid}}, but the buyer's web-console session may not call PATCH /v1/bids/:id (bids#update is not on that app's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor opens a bid on the pricing round with the trade request uuid set to “…”, with the company uuid set to “…”.
The buyer sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Model error”, and never with a server error.
